author: jthelwell
quote: Absolutely amazing game. So atmospheric. Great music. Timeless, game design. Such memorable characters! everything is beautifully remade, emotional, superb story, tight gameplay, makes you smile the whole way through!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: jthelwell
quote: 9 if you’ve taken the time -  with friends - to understand the gameplay mechanics It’s then a very intense and loads of fun competitive  (and fast!) multiplayer like a cross between fzerox smash bros and Mario kart all in one!

author: jthelwell
quote:
Great gameplay, smooth good graphics, superb characters very well developed in this game. original IP and a genuinely new way to play an action game that is engaging, looking forwards to a sequel! Just Wish the game was slightly longer though... 

Top tip -  turn the subtitles on - reading the spoken conversations while playing really helps understand the characters!

author: jthelwell
quote: This is a really entertaining engaging cinematic game. The gameplay visuals audio are all absolutely top quality. Just wish they’d included a 4x4 split screen local multiplayer. Why not Nintendo?!

author: jthelwell
quote: Love this game. Perfectly balanced gameplay. Favourite Switch 2 game to play in short bursts… but totally addictive! My only criticism is would like more control over the rod movements when playing the fish, and there should be a ‘freely moving camera’ so you can initially check out an area quickly  first without having to ride your boat to that area to check it out (but hey thats fishing!). Other than this everything else is spot on! What a lovely game!

author: jthelwell
quote: This is excellent! Atmospheric, great graphics, you feel part of the action, gameplay is in depth, hard and challenging bosses, fun exploration, (the critics have got this one wrong imo) prime 4 is top quality.

author: jthelwell
quote: Excellent multiplayer longevity, such fun to play with 4x4 player split screen my kids! online is also class and teaches you to be strategic which will keep you challenged for years. Superb visuals. In depth gameplay. My score increased on this the more I’ve played it. Few games make you smile like this!
